title: A timeline divides an animation into labelled sections the viewer shows
body:
A canvas `timeline` lists entries such as `1s to 2s { move a 0 80; }`, and `scene::timeline::apply` turns them into tracks. It rejects any property inside `timeline`. `acre-gui` plays the result with a transport bar along the bottom (`App::transport` in `crates/acre-gui/src/app.rs`): play and pause, an egui `Slider` over `0..=duration`, the time, and a loop toggle. `Playback` in `crates/acre-gui/src/playback.rs` holds the time logic. A long animation such as `figures/key-schemes-animated.acre` marks its parts only with comments like `// 1. the types`, and the viewer shows nothing of them.

## Proposal

A `section` line inside `timeline` names the part of the animation that starts at its time:

```text
timeline {
    section 0s "Title";
    0s to 0.6s { fade intro in; }

    section 4s "The types";
    4s to 4.4s { fade p1 in; }
}
```

- A section runs from its time until the next section starts, or until the end.
- When the first section starts after 0s, the stretch before it has no label.
- Two sections at one time, or a section past the duration, is an error at that line.
- A timeline without sections plays as before.

The parser already reads `section 4s "The types";` as a property, so `lang` does not change. `scene` accepts this one key in a `timeline`.

`Scene` gets `sections: Vec<Section>`, each with a `start` in seconds and a `title`, sorted by start.

In `acre-gui`:

- A painted bar replaces the `Slider`. It draws a divider at each section start and the title centred in each section, cut short with an ellipsis when it does not fit. Clicking or dragging seeks.
- A `Sections` toggle next to `Loop` shows a left-hand panel listing each section with its start time. The panel highlights the current section, and clicking a section seeks to its start. The panel starts open and keeps its state across reloads.

## Out of scope

Chapter metadata in the MP4 that `acre render` writes.

## Cost

`Scene` gains a public field, a minor bump for `acre`, with entries in both changed crates' changelogs.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/0c799e42
notes.text: Jack wants no key bindings in the viewer. The `[`, `]` and `S` keys this issue first proposed are gone, and so are the older Space, Left, Right and Home bindings from acre-a96693. `App::keys` and `Playback::step` went with them. The sections panel sits on the left, as Jack asked.
